python.artwork: Official two-snake device with two vector paths and no wordmark.
python.rendering_note: Only the separate grey shadow ellipse is omitted. Both official snake paths, colours and gradients are preserved.

assembly.origin: Artwork supplied by the user for this poster.
assembly.credit: ASM artwork supplied by the user.
assembly.artwork: Blue hexagon with white ASM lettering. Original polygons and clip path with live SVG text.
assembly.rendering_changes: Only the live text is outlined using the recorded Nimbus Sans font. Polygon vertices, colours, clipping, canvas and proportions remain unchanged.

text_outlining.method: Only the live ASM text is converted to vector glyph paths through CairoSVG PDF text and PyMuPDF SVG path export. Original polygons and clipping geometry are retained.
text_outlining.font_source: NimbusSans-Regular.otf from the pinned graph-plotting bundle
text_outlining.font_license_note: The font is under GNU AGPL version 3 with the font document-embedding exception. No font binary is redistributed.
